[316](#316)}
[317](#317)
[318](#318)#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
[319](#319)#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
[320](#320)pub enum RecallDecision {
[321](#321)    AdmitAuthoritative,
[322](#322)    AdmitBackground,
[323](#323)    DemoteArtifact,
[324](#324)    QuarantineSpeculative,
[325](#325)    RejectNoise,
[326](#326)}
[327](#327)
[328](#328)#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
[329](#329)pub struct RecallFilterResult {
[330](#330)    pub decision: RecallDecision,
[331](#331)    pub reasons: Vec<String>,
[332](#332)}
[333](#333)
[334](#334)pub fn compact_context(request: CompactRequest) -> Result<CompactResponse, ContextGovernorError> {
[335](#335)    compact_context_with_memory_sink(request, None)
[336](#336)}
[337](#337)
[338](#338)pub fn compact_context_with_memory_sink(
[339](#339)    request: CompactRequest,
[340](#340)    memory_sink: Option<&mut dyn MemorySink>,
[341](#341)) -> Result<CompactResponse, ContextGovernorError> {
[342](#342)    if request.messages.is_empty() {
[343](#343)        return Err(ContextGovernorError::EmptyMessages);
[344](#344)    }
[345](#345)
[346](#346)    let original_tokens = count_tokens_messages(&request.messages, &request.policy);
[347](#347)    let original_hash = hash_messages(&request.messages)?;
[348](#348)    let mut items = classify_messages(&request.session_id, &request.messages, &request.policy);
[349](#349)    score_items(&mut items, request.focus.as_deref());
[350](#350)    let allocator_mode = resolve_allocator(&request.policy);
[351](#351)    let allocator_unknown = {
[352](#352)        let raw = request.policy.allocator.trim().to_lowercase();
[353](#353)        !raw.is_empty()
[354](#354)            && !matches!(
[355](#355)                raw.as_str(),
[356](#356)                "deterministic" | "deterministic_v1" | "aggressive" | "aggressive_v1"
[357](#357)            )
[358](#358)    };
[359](#359)    let mut warning_from_allocator = Vec::new();
[360](#360)    if allocator_unknown {
[361](#361)        warning_from_allocator.push(format!(
[362](#362)            "allocator '{}' is unknown; normalized to '{}'",
[363](#363)            request.policy.allocator,
[364](#364)            allocator_mode.as_str(),
[365](#365)        ));
[366](#366)    }
[367](#367)    let plan = allocate_items(&request.session_id, items, &request.policy, allocator_mode);
[368](#368)    let mut warnings = warning_from_allocator;
[369](#369)    if matches!(
[370](#370)        request.policy.token_counter,
[371](#371)        TokenCounterKind::ApproxChars
[372](#372)            | TokenCounterKind::ApproxWords
[373](#373)            | TokenCounterKind::ProviderChatApprox
[374](#374)    ) {
[375](#375)        warnings.push(
[376](#376)            "token_counter is approximate; provider-native token budgets may differ".to_string(),
[377](#377)        );
[378](#378)    }
[379](#379)    if matches!(
[380](#380)        request.policy.token_counter,
[381](#381)        TokenCounterKind::ProviderChatApprox | TokenCounterKind::TiktokenCl100k
[382](#382)    ) {
[383](#383)        warnings.push(
[384](#384)            "provider_chat_approx includes chat-role overhead but is not a native tokenizer"
[385](#385)                .to_string(),
[386](#386)        );
[387](#387)    }
[388](#388)    if matches!(
[389](#389)        request.policy.token_counter,
[390](#390)        TokenCounterKind::TiktokenCl100k
[391](#391)    ) {
[392](#392)        warnings.push(
[393](#393)            "tiktoken_cl100k requested but native tokenizer feature is not compiled; using provider_chat_approx fallback".to_string(),
[394](#394)        );
[395](#395)    }
[396](#396)
[397](#397)    let exact_store = build_exact_store(&request.messages, &plan);
[398](#398)    let receipt_id = format!("ctxr_{}", Uuid::new_v4().simple());
[399](#399)    let structured_summary = build_structured_summary(&request.messages, &plan);
[400](#400)    let summary = build_summary(
[401](#401)        &request.messages,
[402](#402)        &plan,
[403](#403)        &request.policy,
[404](#404)        &structured_summary,
[405](#405)        &receipt_id,
[406](#406)    );
[407](#407)    let mut compacted_messages =
[408](#408)        assemble_compacted_messages(&request.messages, &plan, &summary, &request.policy);
[409](#409)    if matches!(request.policy.budget_mode, BudgetMode::HardCascade) {
[410](#410)        warnings.push("hard cascade budget mode active".to_string());
[411](#411)    }
[412](#412)
[413](#413)    if matches!(
[414](#414)        request.policy.budget_mode,
[415](#415)        BudgetMode::HardCascade | BudgetMode::FailClosed
[416](#416)    ) {
[417](#417)        compacted_messages = enforce_budget(compacted_messages, &request.policy, &mut warnings)?;
[418](#418)    }
[419](#419)
[420](#420)    let compacted_tokens = count_tokens_messages(&compacted_messages, &request.policy);
[421](#421)    let compacted_hash = hash_messages(&compacted_messages)?;
[422](#422)    let exact_fallback_refs = exact_store
[423](#423)        .iter()
[424](#424)        .filter_map(|stored| {
[425](#425)            plan.items
[426](#426)                .iter()
[427](#427)                .find(|i| i.item_id == stored.item_id)
[428](#428)                .map(|item| ExactFallbackRefV1 {
[429](#429)                    item_id: item.item_id.clone(),
[430](#430)                    start_index: item.start_index,
[431](#431)                    end_index: item.end_index,
[432](#432)                    content_blake3: item.content_blake3.clone(),
[433](#433)                    approx_tokens: item.approx_tokens,
[434](#434)                })
[435](#435)        })
[436](#436)        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[437](#437)
[438](#438)    if compacted_tokens > request.policy.target_tokens {
[439](#439)        warnings.push(format!(
[440](#440)            "compacted output still exceeds target budget: {} > {} tokens",
[441](#441)            compacted_tokens, request.policy.target_tokens
[442](#442)        ));
[443](#443)    }
[444](#444)
[445](#445)    let mut receipt = ContextCompactionReceiptV1 {
[446](#446)        schema: "ContextCompactionReceiptV1".to_string(),
[447](#447)        receipt_id: receipt_id.clone(),
[448](#448)        session_id: request.session_id.clone(),
[449](#449)        parent_session_id: None,
[450](#450)        created_utc: Utc::now(),
[451](#451)        engine: "context-governor".to_string(),
[452](#452)        engine_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
[453](#453)        original_message_count: request.messages.len(),
[454](#454)        compacted_message_count: compacted_messages.len(),
[455](#455)        original_approx_tokens: original_tokens,
[456](#456)        compacted_approx_tokens: compacted_tokens,
[457](#457)        token_savings_estimate: original_tokens as isize - compacted_tokens as isize,
[458](#458)        token_counter: request.policy.token_counter.clone(),
[459](#459)        original_transcript_blake3: original_hash,
[460](#460)        compacted_transcript_blake3: compacted_hash,
[461](#461)        allocation_plan_id: plan.plan_id.clone(),
[462](#462)        semantic_memory_fact_ids: Vec::new(),
[463](#463)        semantic_memory_document_ids: Vec::new(),
[464](#464)        exact_fallback_refs,
[465](#465)        summary_loss_report: build_loss_report(&plan, structured_summary),
[466](#466)        warnings,
[467](#467)    };
[468](#468)
[469](#469)    if request.policy.archive_memory_enabled || request.policy.semantic_memory_enabled {
[470](#470)        if let Some(sink) = memory_sink {
[471](#471)            let compact_response = CompactResponse {
[472](#472)                receipt: receipt.clone(),
[473](#473)                allocation_plan: plan.clone(),
[474](#474)                compacted_messages: compacted_messages.clone(),
[475](#475)                exact_store: exact_store.clone(),
[476](#476)            };
[477](#477)            let outcome = archive_response_to_memory(&compact_response, sink)?;
[478](#478)            receipt.semantic_memory_fact_ids = outcome.record_ids;
[479](#479)            if outcome.records_attempted == 0 {
[480](#480)                receipt.warnings.push(
[481](#481)                    "archive_memory_enabled true but no matching durable/archive candidates were found".to_string(),
[482](#482)                );
[483](#483)            }
[484](#484)            if request.policy.semantic_memory_enabled && !request.policy.archive_memory_enabled {
[485](#485)                receipt
[486](#486)                    .warnings
[487](#487)                    .push("semantic_memory_enabled=true but archive_memory_enabled=false; semantic IDs may be partial".to_string());
[488](#488)            }
[489](#489)        } else {
[490](#490)            receipt.warnings.push(
[491](#491)                "archive requested but no memory sink was supplied; semantic-memory IDs are intentionally empty".to_string(),
[492](#492)            );
[493](#493)        }
[494](#494)    }
[495](#495)
[496](#496)    Ok(CompactResponse {
[497](#497)        receipt,
[498](#498)        allocation_plan: plan,
[499](#499)        compacted_messages,
[500](#500)        exact_store,
[501](#501)    })
[502](#502)}
[503](#503)
[504](#504)pub fn filter_recall_candidate(candidate: &RecallCandidate, query: &str) -> RecallFilterResult {
[505](#505)    let content_l = candidate.content.to_lowercase();
[506](#506)    let source_l = candidate.source.clone().unwrap_or_default().to_lowercase();
[507](#507)    let query_l = query.to_lowercase();
[508](#508)    let mut reasons = Vec::new();
[509](#509)
[510](#510)    let speculative_markers = [
[511](#511)        "likely",
[512](#512)        "would likely",
[513](#513)        "potentially",
[514](#514)        "may indicate",
[515](#515)        "could imply",
[516](#516)        "logically connect",
[517](#517)        "intended to",
[518](#518)        "seems to",
[519](#519)    ];
[520](#520)    if speculative_markers.iter().any(|m| content_l.contains(m)) {
[521](#521)        reasons.push("speculative-language-without-evidence".to_string());
[522](#522)        return RecallFilterResult {
[523](#523)            decision: RecallDecision::QuarantineSpeculative,
[524](#524)            reasons,
[525](#525)        };
[526](#526)    }
[527](#527)
[528](#528)    let artifact_markers = [
[529](#529)        "_spec_pack.zip",
[530](#530)        "_bundle.zip",
[531](#531)        "pack_manifest",
[532](#532)        "mvp_implementation_plan",
[533](#533)        "rollback_and_quarantine_plan",
[534](#534)        "master_codex_implementation_prompt",
[535](#535)        "migration from prior drafts",
[536](#536)        "profile_i",
[537](#537)    ];
[538](#538)    let is_artifact = artifact_markers
[539](#539)        .iter()
[540](#540)        .any(|m| content_l.contains(m) || source_l.contains(m));
[541](#541)    if is_artifact {
[542](#542)        let explicit = [
[543](#543)            "aicc",
[544](#544)            "context pack",
[545](#545)            "pack manifest",
[546](#546)            "zpy",
[547](#547)            "gpt-pro-synthesis",
[548](#548)        ]
[549](#549)        .iter()
[550](#550)        .any(|m| query_l.contains(m));
[551](#551)        reasons.push("artifact-pack-marker".to_string());
[552](#552)        return RecallFilterResult {
[553](#553)            decision: if explicit {
[554](#554)                RecallDecision::AdmitBackground
[555](#555)            } else {
[556](#556)                RecallDecision::RejectNoise
[557](#557)            },
[558](#558)            reasons,
[559](#559)        };
[560](#560)    }
[561](#561)
[562](#562)    if source_l.contains("tool-receipts")
[563](#563)        && !query_l.contains("tool")
[564](#564)        && !query_l.contains("receipt")
[565](#565)    {
[566](#566)        reasons.push("tool-receipt-not-query-matched".to_string());
[567](#567)        return RecallFilterResult {
[568](#568)            decision: RecallDecision::DemoteArtifact,
[569](#569)            reasons,
[570](#570)        };
[571](#571)    }
[572](#572)
[573](#573)    if content_l.contains("verified")
[574](#574)        || content_l.contains("passed")
[575](#575)        || content_l.contains("source:")
[576](#576)    {
[577](#577)        reasons.push("verification-signal".to_string());
[578](#578)        RecallFilterResult {
[579](#579)            decision: RecallDecision::AdmitAuthoritative,
[580](#580)            reasons,
[581](#581)        }
[582](#582)    } else {
[583](#583)        RecallFilterResult {
[584](#584)            decision: RecallDecision::AdmitBackground,
[585](#585)            reasons,
[586](#586)        }
[587](#587)    }
[588](#588)}
[589](#589)
[590](#590)pub fn approx_tokens_text(text: &str) -> usize {
[591](#591)    (text.chars().count() / CHARS_PER_TOKEN).max(1)
[592](#592)}
[593](#593)
[594](#594)fn approx_word_tokens(text: &str) -> usize {
[595](#595)    text.split_whitespace()
[596](#596)        .map(|token| {
[597](#597)            if token.ends_with('.')
[598](#598)                || token.ends_with(',')
[599](#599)                || token.ends_with(';')
[600](#600)                || token.ends_with('!')
[601](#601)                || token.ends_with('?')
[602](#602)            {
[603](#603)                (token.chars().count() / CHARS_PER_TOKEN) + 1
[604](#604)            } else {
[605](#605)                token.chars().count() / CHARS_PER_TOKEN
[606](#606)            }
[607](#607)        })
[608](#608)        .sum::<usize>()
[609](#609)        .max(1)
[610](#610)}
[611](#611)
[612](#612)pub fn approx_tokens_messages(messages: &[Message]) -> usize {
[613](#613)    messages
[614](#614)        .iter()
[615](#615)        .map(|m| approx_tokens_text(&m.content) + 4)
[616](#616)        .sum()
[617](#617)}
[618](#618)
[619](#619)fn count_tokens_text(text: &str, policy: &CompactionPolicy) -> usize {
[620](#620)    match policy.token_counter {
[621](#621)        TokenCounterKind::ApproxChars => approx_tokens_text(text),
[622](#622)        TokenCounterKind::ApproxWords => approx_word_tokens(text),
[623](#623)        TokenCounterKind::ProviderChatApprox | TokenCounterKind::TiktokenCl100k => {
[624](#624)            provider_chat_approx_tokens(text)
[625](#625)        }
[626](#626)    }
[627](#627)}
[628](#628)
[629](#629)fn count_tokens_messages(messages: &[Message], policy: &CompactionPolicy) -> usize {
[630](#630)    messages
[631](#631)        .iter()
[632](#632)        .map(|m| {
[633](#633)            count_tokens_text(&m.content, policy)
[634](#634)                + message_overhead_tokens(policy, &m.role, m.name.as_deref())
[635](#635)        })
[636](#636)        .sum()
[637](#637)}
[638](#638)
[639](#639)fn message_overhead_tokens(policy: &CompactionPolicy, role: &str, name: Option<&str>) -> usize {
[640](#640)    match policy.token_counter {
[641](#641)        TokenCounterKind::ProviderChatApprox | TokenCounterKind::TiktokenCl100k => {
[642](#642)            let role_overhead = match role {
[643](#643)                "system" => 5,
[644](#644)                "user" => 4,
[645](#645)                "assistant" => 4,
[646](#646)                "tool" => 7,
[647](#647)                _ => 4,
[648](#648)            };
[649](#649)            role_overhead + usize::from(name.is_some())
[650](#650)        }
[651](#651)        TokenCounterKind::ApproxChars | TokenCounterKind::ApproxWords => 4,
[652](#652)    }
[653](#653)}
[654](#654)
[655](#655)fn provider_chat_approx_tokens(text: &str) -> usize {
[656](#656)    let chars = text.chars().count();
[657](#657)    let whitespace_tokens = text.split_whitespace().count();
[658](#658)    let punctuation_tokens = text
[659](#659)        .chars()
[660](#660)        .filter(|ch| {
[661](#661)            matches!(
[662](#662)                ch,
[663](#663)                '{' | '}' | '[' | ']' | ':' | ',' | '"' | '`' | '/' | '\\'
[664](#664)            )
[665](#665)        })
[666](#666)        .count()
[667](#667)        / 4;
[668](#668)    let char_estimate = (chars / 4).max(1);
[669](#669)    char_estimate
[670](#670)        .max(whitespace_tokens + punctuation_tokens)
[671](#671)        .max(1)
[672](#672)}
[673](#673)
[674](#674)pub fn hash_messages(messages: &[Message]) -> Result<String, ContextGovernorError> {
[675](#675)    let rendered = serde_json::to_string(messages)?;
[676](#676)    Ok(hash_text(&rendered))
[677](#677)}
[678](#678)
[679](#679)pub fn hash_text(text: &str) -> String {
[680](#680)    blake3::hash(text.as_bytes()).to_hex().to_string()
[681](#681)}
[682](#682)
[683](#683)fn classify_messages(
[684](#684)    session_id: &str,
[685](#685)    messages: &[Message],
[686](#686)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[687](#687)) -> Vec<ContextItemV1> {
[688](#688)    let latest_user = messages
[689](#689)        .iter()
[690](#690)        .rposition(|m| m.role == "user")
[691](#691)        .unwrap_or(messages.len() - 1);
[692](#692)    let mut seen_hashes = BTreeSet::new();
[693](#693)    messages
[694](#694)        .iter()
[695](#695)        .enumerate()
[696](#696)        .map(|(idx, msg)| {
[697](#697)            let h = hash_text(&msg.content);
[698](#698)            let duplicate = !seen_hashes.insert(h.clone());
[699](#699)            classify_message(session_id, idx, latest_user, msg, h, duplicate, policy)
[700](#700)        })
[701](#701)        .collect()
[702](#702)}
[703](#703)
[704](#704)fn classify_message(
[705](#705)    session_id: &str,
[706](#706)    idx: usize,
[707](#707)    latest_user: usize,
[708](#708)    msg: &Message,
[709](#709)    content_hash: String,
[710](#710)    duplicate: bool,
[711](#711)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[712](#712)) -> ContextItemV1 {
[713](#713)    let content_l = msg.content.to_lowercase();
[714](#714)    let aggressive = is_aggressive_allocator(policy);
[715](#715)    let counted_tokens = count_tokens_text(&msg.content, policy);
[716](#716)    let msg_chars = msg.content.chars().count();
[717](#717)    let long_message = msg_chars > 600;
[718](#718)    let mut item_type = ItemType::LowRiskNarrative;
[719](#719)    let mut authority = AuthorityClass::SummaryOk;
[720](#720)    let mut policy = PreservationPolicy::ExtractiveSummary;
[721](#721)    let mut reasons = Vec::new();
[722](#722)
[723](#723)    if idx == latest_user && msg.role == "user" {
[724](#724)        item_type = ItemType::LatestUserMessage;
[725](#725)        authority = AuthorityClass::ActiveTask;
[726](#726)        policy = PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim;
[727](#727)        reasons.push("latest-user-message".to_string());
[728](#728)    } else if duplicate {
[729](#729)        item_type = ItemType::DuplicateContext;
[730](#730)        authority = AuthorityClass::Discardable;
[731](#731)        policy = PreservationPolicy::OmitDuplicate;
[732](#732)        reasons.push("duplicate-content".to_string());
[733](#733)    } else if contains_any(
[734](#734)        &content_l,
[735](#735)        &[
[736](#736)            "acceptance gate",
[737](#737)            "must pass",
[738](#738)            "required",
[739](#739)            "requirement",
[740](#740)            "do not",
[741](#741)            "never ",
[742](#742)        ],
[743](#743)    ) {
[744](#744)        item_type = ItemType::AcceptanceGate;
[745](#745)        authority = AuthorityClass::MustPreserveExact;
[746](#746)        policy = if aggressive && long_message {
[747](#747)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly
[748](#748)        } else {
[749](#749)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim
[750](#750)        };
[751](#751)        reasons.push("acceptance-or-instruction".to_string());
[752](#752)    } else if contains_any(
[753](#753)        &content_l,
[754](#754)        &[
[755](#755)            "error:",
[756](#756)            "error[",
[757](#757)            "traceback",
[758](#758)            "panic",
[759](#759)            "failed",
[760](#760)            "compilation failed",
[761](#761)            "exit_code\":1",
[762](#762)            "exit code 1",
[763](#763)        ],
[764](#764)    ) {
[765](#765)        item_type = ItemType::ErrorOutput;
[766](#766)        authority = AuthorityClass::EvidenceCritical;
[767](#767)        policy = if msg.role == "tool" && msg.content.chars().count() > 600 {
[768](#768)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly
[769](#769)        } else {
[770](#770)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim
[771](#771)        };
[772](#772)        reasons.push("error-output".to_string());
[773](#773)    } else if contains_path_signal(&msg.content) {
[774](#774)        item_type = ItemType::FilePathContext;
[775](#775)        authority = AuthorityClass::EvidenceCritical;
[776](#776)        policy = if aggressive && long_message {
[777](#777)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly
[778](#778)        } else {
[779](#779)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim
[780](#780)        };
[781](#781)        reasons.push("path-signal".to_string());
[782](#782)    } else if msg.role == "tool" {
[783](#783)        item_type = ItemType::ToolResult;
[784](#784)        authority = AuthorityClass::VerifiedToolReceipt;
[785](#785)        policy = if msg.content.chars().count() > 600 {
[786](#786)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly
[787](#787)        } else {
[788](#788)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim
[789](#789)        };
[790](#790)        reasons.push("tool-result".to_string());
[791](#791)    } else if contains_any(
[792](#792)        &content_l,
[793](#793)        &["decided", "decision", "architecture", "verdict"],
[794](#794)    ) {
[795](#795)        item_type = ItemType::Decision;
[796](#796)        authority = AuthorityClass::DurableMemoryCandidate;
[797](#797)        policy = PreservationPolicy::SemanticMemoryArchive;
[798](#798)        reasons.push("decision-signal".to_string());
[799](#799)    } else if contains_any(&content_l, &["source:", "evidence", "verified", "receipt"]) {
[800](#800)        item_type = ItemType::SourceEvidence;
[801](#801)        authority = AuthorityClass::EvidenceCritical;
[802](#802)        policy = if aggressive && long_message {
[803](#803)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly
[804](#804)        } else {
[805](#805)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim
[806](#806)        };
[807](#807)        reasons.push("evidence-signal".to_string());
[808](#808)    }
[809](#809)
[810](#810)    if contains_any(
[811](#811)        &content_l,
[812](#812)        &[
[813](#813)            "likely",
[814](#814)            "potentially",
[815](#815)            "would likely",
[816](#816)            "may indicate",
[817](#817)            "logically connect",
[818](#818)        ],
[819](#819)    ) {
[820](#820)        item_type = ItemType::ArtifactBoilerplate;
[821](#821)        authority = AuthorityClass::Quarantine;
[822](#822)        policy = PreservationPolicy::Quarantine;
[823](#823)        reasons.push("speculative-language".to_string());
[824](#824)    }
[825](#825)
[826](#826)    ContextItemV1 {
[827](#827)        schema: "ContextItemV1".to_string(),
[828](#828)        item_id: format!("ctxi_{idx:04}_{}", &content_hash[..12]),
[829](#829)        session_id: session_id.to_string(),
[830](#830)        start_index: idx,
[831](#831)        end_index: idx,
[832](#832)        role_set: vec![msg.role.clone()],
[833](#833)        char_count: msg.content.chars().count(),
[834](#834)        approx_tokens: counted_tokens,
[835](#835)        content_blake3: content_hash,
[836](#836)        content_kind: detect_content_kind(&msg.role, &msg.content),
[837](#837)        item_type,
[838](#838)        authority_class: authority,
[839](#839)        preservation_policy: policy,
[840](#840)        risk_reasons: reasons,
[841](#841)        source_message_ids: msg.id.clone().into_iter().collect(),
[842](#842)        priority_score: 0,
[843](#843)    }
[844](#844)}
[845](#845)
[846](#846)fn resolve_allocator(policy: &CompactionPolicy) -> AllocatorMode {
[847](#847)    if policy.allocator.trim().is_empty() {
[848](#848)        return AllocatorMode::DeterministicV1;
[849](#849)    }
[850](#850)    match policy.allocator.trim().to_lowercase().as_str() {
[851](#851)        "deterministic" | "deterministic_v1" => AllocatorMode::DeterministicV1,
[852](#852)        "aggressive" | "aggressive_v1" => AllocatorMode::AggressiveV1,
[853](#853)        _ => AllocatorMode::DeterministicV1,
[854](#854)    }
[855](#855)}
[856](#856)
[857](#857)fn is_aggressive_allocator(policy: &CompactionPolicy) -> bool {
[858](#858)    matches!(resolve_allocator(policy), AllocatorMode::AggressiveV1)
[859](#859)}
[860](#860)fn is_aggressive_allocator_mode(mode: &AllocatorMode) -> bool {
[861](#861)    matches!(mode, AllocatorMode::AggressiveV1)
[862](#862)}
[863](#863)
[864](#864)fn score_items(items: &mut [ContextItemV1], focus: Option<&str>) {
[865](#865)    for item in items {
[866](#866)        let mut score = match item.item_type {
[867](#867)            ItemType::LatestUserMessage => 1000,
[868](#868)            ItemType::ActiveInstruction => 900,
[869](#869)            ItemType::AcceptanceGate => 850,
[870](#870)            ItemType::ErrorOutput => 800,
[871](#871)            ItemType::SourceEvidence => 750,
[872](#872)            ItemType::ToolResult => 650,
[873](#873)            ItemType::FilePathContext => 650,
[874](#874)            ItemType::Decision => 600,
[875](#875)            ItemType::UnresolvedQuestion => 575,
[876](#876)            ItemType::DurableFactCandidate | ItemType::ProjectStateCandidate => 500,
[877](#877)            ItemType::LowRiskNarrative => 100,
[878](#878)            ItemType::ArtifactBoilerplate => -300,
[879](#879)            ItemType::StalePlan => -350,
[880](#880)            ItemType::DuplicateContext => -500,
[881](#881)            ItemType::Unknown | ItemType::ToolCall => 50,
[882](#882)        };
[883](#883)        if matches!(
[884](#884)            item.authority_class,
[885](#885)            AuthorityClass::MustPreserveExact | AuthorityClass::ActiveTask
[886](#886)        ) {
[887](#887)            score += 300;
[888](#888)        }
[889](#889)        if focus.is_some() && !matches!(item.preservation_policy, PreservationPolicy::Quarantine) {
[890](#890)            score += 25;
[891](#891)        }
[892](#892)        item.priority_score = score;
[893](#893)    }
[894](#894)}
[895](#895)
[896](#896)fn allocate_items(
[897](#897)    session_id: &str,
[898](#898)    items: Vec<ContextItemV1>,
[899](#899)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[900](#900)    allocator: AllocatorMode,
[901](#901)) -> ContextAllocationPlanV1 {
[902](#902)    let mut used_tokens = 0usize;
[903](#903)    let mut kept = Vec::new();
[904](#904)    let mut summarized = Vec::new();
[905](#905)    let mut archived = Vec::new();
[906](#906)    let mut omitted = Vec::new();
[907](#907)    let mut quarantined = Vec::new();
[908](#908)
[909](#909)    let len = items.len();
[910](#910)    let aggressive = is_aggressive_allocator_mode(&allocator);
[911](#911)    for item in &items {
[912](#912)        let in_head = item.start_index < policy.protect_first_n;
[913](#913)        let in_tail = item.start_index + policy.protect_last_n >= len;
[914](#914)        let protected_head = in_head && (!aggressive || item.approx_tokens <= 1_000);
[915](#915)        let protected_tail = in_tail
[916](#916)            && (!aggressive
[917](#917)                || item.approx_tokens <= 300
[918](#918)                || matches!(item.item_type, ItemType::LatestUserMessage));
[919](#919)        match item.preservation_policy {
[920](#920)            PreservationPolicy::Quarantine => quarantined.push(item.item_id.clone()),
[921](#921)            PreservationPolicy::OmitDuplicate => omitted.push(item.item_id.clone()),
[922](#922)            PreservationPolicy::SemanticMemoryArchive => {
[923](#923)                archived.push(item.item_id.clone());
[924](#924)                if protected_tail || item.priority_score >= 650 {
[925](#925)                    kept.push(item.item_id.clone());
[926](#926)                    used_tokens = used_tokens.saturating_add(item.approx_tokens);
[927](#927)                } else {
[928](#928)                    summarized.push(item.item_id.clone());
[929](#929)                }
[930](#930)            }
[931](#931)            PreservationPolicy::KeepVerbatim => {
[932](#932)                let must_keep = matches!(item.item_type, ItemType::LatestUserMessage)
[933](#933)                    || protected_head
[934](#934)                    || (!aggressive && protected_tail);
[935](#935)                let fits_aggressive_budget = !aggressive
[936](#936)                    || used_tokens + item.approx_tokens <= policy.target_tokens.saturating_div(2);
[937](#937)                if must_keep || fits_aggressive_budget {
[938](#938)                    kept.push(item.item_id.clone());
[939](#939)                    used_tokens = used_tokens.saturating_add(item.approx_tokens);
[940](#940)                } else {
[941](#941)                    summarized.push(item.item_id.clone());
[942](#942)                }
[943](#943)            }
[944](#944)            PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly => {
[945](#945)                if protected_head
[946](#946)                    || protected_tail
[947](#947)                    || used_tokens + item.approx_tokens <= policy.target_tokens
[948](#948)                {
[949](#949)                    summarized.push(item.item_id.clone());
[950](#950)                } else {
[951](#951)                    omitted.push(item.item_id.clone());
[952](#952)                }
[953](#953)            }
[954](#954)            PreservationPolicy::ExtractiveSummary | PreservationPolicy::AbstractiveSummary => {
[955](#955)                let must_keep = matches!(item.item_type, ItemType::LatestUserMessage)
[956](#956)                    || protected_head
[957](#957)                    || protected_tail;
[958](#958)                if must_keep
[959](#959)                    || (!aggressive && used_tokens + item.approx_tokens <= policy.target_tokens / 2)
[960](#960)                {
[961](#961)                    kept.push(item.item_id.clone());
[962](#962)                    used_tokens = used_tokens.saturating_add(item.approx_tokens);
[963](#963)                } else {
[964](#964)                    summarized.push(item.item_id.clone());
[965](#965)                }
[966](#966)            }
[967](#967)        }
[968](#968)    }
[969](#969)
[970](#970)    ContextAllocationPlanV1 {
[971](#971)        schema: "ContextAllocationPlanV1".to_string(),
[972](#972)        plan_id: format!("ctxp_{}", Uuid::new_v4().simple()),
[973](#973)        session_id: session_id.to_string(),
[974](#974)        created_utc: Utc::now(),
[975](#975)        context_budget_tokens: policy.target_tokens,
[976](#976)        target_output_tokens: policy.target_tokens,
[977](#977)        allocator: allocator.as_str().to_string(),
[978](#978)        items,
[979](#979)        kept_item_ids: kept,
[980](#980)        summarized_item_ids: summarized,
[981](#981)        archived_item_ids: archived,
[982](#982)        omitted_item_ids: omitted,
[983](#983)        quarantined_item_ids: quarantined,
[984](#984)    }
[985](#985)}
[986](#986)
[987](#987)fn build_exact_store(
[988](#988)    messages: &[Message],
[989](#989)    plan: &ContextAllocationPlanV1,
[990](#990)) -> Vec<ExactStoredItemV1> {
[991](#991)    plan.items
[992](#992)        .iter()
[993](#993)        .filter(|item| {
[994](#994)            plan.summarized_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[995](#995)                || plan.archived_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[996](#996)                || plan.omitted_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[997](#997)                || plan.quarantined_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[998](#998)                || matches!(item.preservation_policy, PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly)
[999](#999)        })
[1000](#1000)        .filter_map(|item| {
[1001](#1001)            messages.get(item.start_index).map(|m| ExactStoredItemV1 {
[1002](#1002)                item_id: item.item_id.clone(),
[1003](#1003)                source_indices: vec![item.start_index],
[1004](#1004)                content: m.content.clone(),
[1005](#1005)                content_blake3: item.content_blake3.clone(),
[1006](#1006)            })
[1007](#1007)        })
[1008](#1008)        .collect()
[1009](#1009)}
[1010](#1010)
[1011](#1011)fn build_structured_summary(
[1012](#1012)    messages: &[Message],
[1013](#1013)    plan: &ContextAllocationPlanV1,
[1014](#1014)) -> StructuredContextSummaryV1 {
[1015](#1015)    let mut out = StructuredContextSummaryV1 {
[1016](#1016)        active_task: messages
[1017](#1017)            .iter()
[1018](#1018)            .rev()
[1019](#1019)            .find(|m| m.role == "user")
[1020](#1020)            .map(|m| compact_preview(&m.content, 240)),
[1021](#1021)        fallback_item_ids: plan
[1022](#1022)            .summarized_item_ids
[1023](#1023)            .iter()
[1024](#1024)            .chain(plan.omitted_item_ids.iter())
[1025](#1025)            .chain(plan.quarantined_item_ids.iter())
[1026](#1026)            .cloned()
[1027](#1027)            .collect(),
[1028](#1028)        ..Default::default()
[1029](#1029)    };
[1030](#1030)
[1031](#1031)    for msg in messages {
[1032](#1032)        let content_l = msg.content.to_lowercase();
[1033](#1033)        if content_l.contains("acceptance gate") || content_l.contains("must pass") {
[1034](#1034)            push_unique(
[1035](#1035)                &mut out.acceptance_gates,
[1036](#1036)                compact_preview(&msg.content, 240),
[1037](#1037)            );
[1038](#1038)        }
[1039](#1039)        if content_l.contains("decision:") || content_l.contains("decided") {
[1040](#1040)            push_unique(&mut out.decisions, compact_preview(&msg.content, 240));
[1041](#1041)        }
[1042](#1042)        if content_l.contains("unresolved question") || content_l.contains('?') {
[1043](#1043)            push_unique(
[1044](#1044)                &mut out.unresolved_questions,
[1045](#1045)                compact_preview(&msg.content, 240),
[1046](#1046)            );
[1047](#1047)        }
[1048](#1048)        if content_l.contains("error")
[1049](#1049)            || content_l.contains("traceback")
[1050](#1050)            || content_l.contains("failed")
[1051](#1051)        {
[1052](#1052)            push_unique(
[1053](#1053)                &mut out.errors,
[1054](#1054)                important_lines(&msg.content, &["error", "failed", "traceback"], 240),
[1055](#1055)            );
[1056](#1056)        }
[1057](#1057)        for file in extract_file_like_tokens(&msg.content) {
[1058](#1058)            push_unique(&mut out.files, file);
[1059](#1059)        }
[1060](#1060)        for command in extract_command_like_lines(&msg.content) {
[1061](#1061)            push_unique(&mut out.commands, command);
[1062](#1062)        }
[1063](#1063)    }
[1064](#1064)    out
[1065](#1065)}
[1066](#1066)
[1067](#1067)fn push_summary_list(lines: &mut Vec<String>, label: &str, values: &[String]) {
[1068](#1068)    if values.is_empty() {
[1069](#1069)        return;
[1070](#1070)    }
[1071](#1071)    lines.push(format!("- {label}:"));
[1072](#1072)    for value in values.iter().take(5) {
[1073](#1073)        lines.push(format!("  - {}", compact_preview(value, 220)));
[1074](#1074)    }
[1075](#1075)}
[1076](#1076)
[1077](#1077)fn push_unique(values: &mut Vec<String>, value: String) {
[1078](#1078)    if !value.is_empty() && !values.contains(&value) {
[1079](#1079)        values.push(value);
[1080](#1080)    }
[1081](#1081)}
[1082](#1082)
[1083](#1083)fn extract_file_like_tokens(text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
[1084](#1084)    text.split_whitespace()
[1085](#1085)        .map(|token| {
[1086](#1086)            token.trim_matches(|c: char| {
[1087](#1087)                c == ',' || c == ':' || c == ';' || c == ')' || c == '(' || c == '`' || c == '"'
[1088](#1088)            })
[1089](#1089)        })
[1090](#1090)        .filter(|token| {
[1091](#1091)            token.contains("/home/")
[1092](#1092)                || token.contains("/usr/")
[1093](#1093)                || token.contains("/etc/")
[1094](#1094)                || token.contains("/var/")
[1095](#1095)                || token.contains("/tmp/")
[1096](#1096)                || token.starts_with("~/")
[1097](#1097)                || token.starts_with("/")
[1098](#1098)                || token.ends_with(".rs")
[1099](#1099)                || token.ends_with(".py")
[1100](#1100)                || token.ends_with(".ts")
[1101](#1101)                || token.ends_with(".tsx")
[1102](#1102)                || token.ends_with(".js")
[1103](#1103)                || token.ends_with(".md")
[1104](#1104)                || token.ends_with(".toml")
[1105](#1105)                || token.ends_with(".yaml")
[1106](#1106)                || token.ends_with(".yml")
[1107](#1107)                || token.ends_with(".json")
[1108](#1108)                || token.ends_with(".go")
[1109](#1109)                || token.ends_with(".c")
[1110](#1110)                || token.ends_with(".h")
[1111](#1111)        })
[1112](#1112)        .map(|token| token.to_string())
[1113](#1113)        .collect()
[1114](#1114)}
[1115](#1115)
[1116](#1116)fn extract_command_like_lines(text: &str) -> Vec<String> {
[1117](#1117)    text.lines()
[1118](#1118)        .map(str::trim)
[1119](#1119)        .filter(|line| {
[1120](#1120)            line.starts_with("running:")
[1121](#1121)                || line.starts_with('$')
[1122](#1122)                || line.starts_with("cargo ")
[1123](#1123)                || line.starts_with("npm ")
[1124](#1124)                || line.starts_with("python ")
[1125](#1125)                || line.starts_with("git ")
[1126](#1126)        })
[1127](#1127)        .map(|line| compact_preview(line, 240))
[1128](#1128)        .collect()
[1129](#1129)}
[1130](#1130)
[1131](#1131)fn important_lines(text: &str, needles: &[&str], max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1132](#1132)    let mut out = Vec::new();
[1133](#1133)    for line in text.lines() {
[1134](#1134)        let line_l = line.to_lowercase();
[1135](#1135)        if needles.iter().any(|needle| line_l.contains(needle)) {
[1136](#1136)            out.push(line.trim());
[1137](#1137)        }
[1138](#1138)        if out.len() >= 5 {
[1139](#1139)            break;
[1140](#1140)        }
[1141](#1141)    }
[1142](#1142)    if out.is_empty() {
[1143](#1143)        compact_preview(text, max_chars)
[1144](#1144)    } else {
[1145](#1145)        compact_preview(&out.join(" | "), max_chars)
[1146](#1146)    }
[1147](#1147)}
[1148](#1148)
[1149](#1149)fn build_summary(
[1150](#1150)    messages: &[Message],
[1151](#1151)    plan: &ContextAllocationPlanV1,
[1152](#1152)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[1153](#1153)    structured: &StructuredContextSummaryV1,
[1154](#1154)    receipt_id: &str,
[1155](#1155)) -> String {
[1156](#1156)    let mut lines = vec![
[1157](#1157)        format!("{SUMMARY_PREFIX}"),
[1158](#1158)        "Earlier turns were compacted. This summary is background, not an active task.".to_string(),
[1159](#1159)        "Only the latest user message after this summary is active.".to_string(),
[1160](#1160)        format!("Use context_expand(receipt_id=\"{receipt_id}\", item_id=...) to recover exact omitted text when needed."),
[1161](#1161)        String::new(),
[1162](#1162)        "## Structured anchors".to_string(),
[1163](#1163)    ];
[1164](#1164)    if let Some(active_task) = &structured.active_task {
[1165](#1165)        lines.push(format!(
[1166](#1166)            "- active_task: {}",
[1167](#1167)            compact_preview(active_task, 220)
[1168](#1168)        ));
[1169](#1169)    }
[1170](#1170)    push_summary_list(&mut lines, "acceptance_gates", &structured.acceptance_gates);
[1171](#1171)    push_summary_list(&mut lines, "commands", &structured.commands);
[1172](#1172)    push_summary_list(&mut lines, "errors", &structured.errors);
[1173](#1173)    push_summary_list(&mut lines, "files", &structured.files);
[1174](#1174)    push_summary_list(&mut lines, "decisions", &structured.decisions);
[1175](#1175)    push_summary_list(
[1176](#1176)        &mut lines,
[1177](#1177)        "unresolved_questions",
[1178](#1178)        &structured.unresolved_questions,
[1179](#1179)    );
[1180](#1180)    if !structured.fallback_item_ids.is_empty() {
[1181](#1181)        let shown = structured
[1182](#1182)            .fallback_item_ids
[1183](#1183)            .iter()
[1184](#1184)            .take(30)
[1185](#1185)            .cloned()
[1186](#1186)            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[1187](#1187)        let hidden = structured
[1188](#1188)            .fallback_item_ids
[1189](#1189)            .len()
[1190](#1190)            .saturating_sub(shown.len());
[1191](#1191)        let suffix = if hidden > 0 {
[1192](#1192)            format!(" (+{hidden} more in receipt)")
[1193](#1193)        } else {
[1194](#1194)            String::new()
[1195](#1195)        };
[1196](#1196)        lines.push(format!(
[1197](#1197)            "- fallback_item_ids: {}{}",
[1198](#1198)            shown.join(", "),
[1199](#1199)            suffix
[1200](#1200)        ));
[1201](#1201)    }
[1202](#1202)
[1203](#1203)    lines.push(String::new());
[1204](#1204)    lines.push("## Preserved / summarized context".to_string());
[1205](#1205)    for item in &plan.items {
[1206](#1206)        if plan.summarized_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[1207](#1207)            || plan.archived_item_ids.contains(&item.item_id)
[1208](#1208)            || matches!(item.preservation_policy, PreservationPolicy::ReceiptOnly)
[1209](#1209)        {
[1210](#1210)            if let Some(msg) = messages.get(item.start_index) {
[1211](#1211)                let preview = content_aware_preview(&item.content_kind, &msg.content, 220);
[1212](#1212)                lines.push(format!(
[1213](#1213)                    "- {} {:?}/{:?}/{:?}: {}",
[1214](#1214)                    item.item_id,
[1215](#1215)                    item.item_type,
[1216](#1216)                    item.content_kind,
[1217](#1217)                    item.preservation_policy,
[1218](#1218)                    preview
[1219](#1219)                ));
[1220](#1220)            }
[1221](#1221)        }
[1222](#1222)    }
[1223](#1223)    if !plan.quarantined_item_ids.is_empty() {
[1224](#1224)        lines.push(String::new());
[1225](#1225)        lines.push(format!(
[1226](#1226)            "## Quarantined context\n{} items were excluded from authoritative context due to speculative/artifact signals; exact fallback remains available.",
[1227](#1227)            plan.quarantined_item_ids.len()
[1228](#1228)        ));
[1229](#1229)    }
[1230](#1230)    let mut summary = lines.join("\n");
[1231](#1231)    if summary.chars().count() > policy.summary_max_chars {
[1232](#1232)        summary = summary
[1233](#1233)            .chars()
[1234](#1234)            .take(policy.summary_max_chars)
[1235](#1235)            .collect::<String>();
[1236](#1236)        summary.push_str("\n[summary truncated by context-governor budget]");
[1237](#1237)    }
[1238](#1238)    summary
[1239](#1239)}
[1240](#1240)
[1241](#1241)fn assemble_compacted_messages(
[1242](#1242)    messages: &[Message],
[1243](#1243)    plan: &ContextAllocationPlanV1,
[1244](#1244)    summary: &str,
[1245](#1245)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[1246](#1246)) -> Vec<Message> {
[1247](#1247)    let mut out = Vec::new();
[1248](#1248)    let kept_set = plan.kept_item_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
[1249](#1249)    let aggressive = is_aggressive_allocator(policy);
[1250](#1250)    let item_by_index = plan
[1251](#1251)        .items
[1252](#1252)        .iter()
[1253](#1253)        .map(|i| (i.start_index, i))
[1254](#1254)        .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
[1255](#1255)
[1256](#1256)    let tail_start = messages.len().saturating_sub(policy.protect_last_n);
[1257](#1257)
[1258](#1258)    for (idx, msg) in messages.iter().enumerate() {
[1259](#1259)        if idx >= tail_start {
[1260](#1260)            continue;
[1261](#1261)        }
[1262](#1262)        if idx < policy.protect_first_n {
[1263](#1263)            let Some(item) = item_by_index.get(&idx) else {
[1264](#1264)                out.push(msg.clone());
[1265](#1265)                continue;
[1266](#1266)            };
[1267](#1267)            let keep_head = matches!(item.item_type, ItemType::LatestUserMessage)
[1268](#1268)                || (kept_set.contains(&item.item_id)
[1269](#1269)                    && (!aggressive || item.approx_tokens <= 1_000))
[1270](#1270)                || (matches!(
[1271](#1271)                    item.authority_class,
[1272](#1272)                    AuthorityClass::MustPreserveExact | AuthorityClass::ActiveTask
[1273](#1273)                ) && (!aggressive || item.approx_tokens <= 1_000));
[1274](#1274)            if keep_head {
[1275](#1275)                out.push(msg.clone());
[1276](#1276)            }
[1277](#1277)        } else if let Some(item) = item_by_index.get(&idx) {
[1278](#1278)            if kept_set.contains(&item.item_id)
[1279](#1279)                && !out
[1280](#1280)                    .iter()
[1281](#1281)                    .any(|m: &Message| m.content == msg.content && m.role == msg.role)
[1282](#1282)            {
[1283](#1283)                out.push(msg.clone());
[1284](#1284)            }
[1285](#1285)        }
[1286](#1286)    }
[1287](#1287)
[1288](#1288)    let summary_msg = Message {
[1289](#1289)        id: Some(format!("summary_{}", plan.plan_id)),
[1290](#1290)        role: choose_summary_role(out.last().map(|m| m.role.as_str())).to_string(),
[1291](#1291)        content: summary.to_string(),
[1292](#1292)        name: Some("context_governor".to_string()),
[1293](#1293)        metadata: BTreeMap::from([("compressed_summary".to_string(), Value::Bool(true))]),
[1294](#1294)    };
[1295](#1295)    out.push(summary_msg);
[1296](#1296)
[1297](#1297)    for (offset, msg) in messages[tail_start..].iter().enumerate() {
[1298](#1298)        let idx = tail_start + offset;
[1299](#1299)        let _ = item_by_index.get(&idx); let should_keep_tail = !out
[1305](#1305)            .iter()
[1306](#1306)            .any(|m: &Message| m.content == msg.content && m.role == msg.role);
[1307](#1307)        if should_keep_tail {
[1308](#1308)            out.push(msg.clone());
[1309](#1309)        }
[1310](#1310)    }
[1311](#1311)    out
[1312](#1312)}
[1313](#1313)
[1314](#1314)fn choose_summary_role(previous: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
[1315](#1315)    match previous {
[1316](#1316)        Some("assistant") => "user",
[1317](#1317)        _ => "assistant",
[1318](#1318)    }

[1321](#1321)fn build_loss_report(
[1322](#1322)    plan: &ContextAllocationPlanV1,
[1323](#1323)    structured_summary: StructuredContextSummaryV1,
[1324](#1324)) -> SummaryLossReportV1 {
[1325](#1325)    SummaryLossReportV1 {
[1326](#1326)        schema: "SummaryLossReportV1".to_string(),
[1327](#1327)        preserved_claims: plan.kept_item_ids.clone(),
[1328](#1328)        omitted_claims: plan.omitted_item_ids.clone(),
[1329](#1329)        evidence_lost: plan
[1330](#1330)            .omitted_item_ids
[1331](#1331)            .iter()
[1332](#1332)            .chain(plan.summarized_item_ids.iter())
[1333](#1333)            .cloned()
[1334](#1334)            .collect(),
[1335](#1335)        uncertainty_introduced: plan.quarantined_item_ids.clone(),
[1336](#1336)        exact_recovery_available: true,
[1337](#1337)        high_risk_omissions: plan
[1338](#1338)            .items
[1339](#1339)            .iter()
[1340](#1340)            .filter(|i| {
[1341](#1341)                plan.omitted_item_ids.contains(&i.item_id)
[1342](#1342)                    && matches!(
[1343](#1343)                        i.authority_class,
[1344](#1344)                        AuthorityClass::MustPreserveExact | AuthorityClass::EvidenceCritical
[1345](#1345)                    )
[1346](#1346)            })
[1347](#1347)            .map(|i| i.item_id.clone())
[1348](#1348)            .collect(),
[1349](#1349)        structured_summary,
[1350](#1350)    }

[1353](#1353)fn compact_preview(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1354](#1354)    let clean = text.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
[1355](#1355)    if clean.chars().count() <= max_chars {
[1356](#1356)        clean
[1357](#1357)    } else {
[1358](#1358)        let mut s = clean.chars().take(max_chars).collect::<String>();
[1359](#1359)        s.push_str("...");
[1360](#1360)        s
[1361](#1361)    }

[1363](#1363)
[1364](#1364)fn content_aware_preview(kind: &ContentKind, text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1365](#1365)    match kind {
[1366](#1366)        ContentKind::Json => json_preview(text, max_chars),
[1367](#1367)        ContentKind::Diff => important_lines(text, &["diff --git", "@@", "+++", "---"], max_chars),
[1368](#1368)        ContentKind::CargoOutput => important_lines(
[1369](#1369)            text,
[1370](#1370)            &["error", "warning", "test result", "failed", "finished"],
[1371](#1371)            max_chars,
[1372](#1372)        ),
[1373](#1373)        ContentKind::ShellLog => {
[1374](#1374)            important_lines(text, &["error", "failed", "exit", "$"], max_chars)
[1375](#1375)        }
[1376](#1376)        ContentKind::SearchResults => important_lines(
[1377](#1377)            text,
[1378](#1378)            &["/home/", ":", "LINE", "match", ".rs", ".py", ".md"],
[1379](#1379)            max_chars,
[1380](#1380)        ),
[1381](#1381)        ContentKind::Rust => important_lines(
[1382](#1382)            text,
[1383](#1383)            &["pub ", "fn ", "struct ", "impl ", "use ", "error", "TODO"],
[1384](#1384)            max_chars,
[1385](#1385)        ),
[1386](#1386)        ContentKind::Markdown => important_lines(text, &["#", "##", "- ", "```"], max_chars),
[1387](#1387)        _ => compact_preview(text, max_chars),
[1388](#1388)    }
[1389](#1389)}
[1390](#1390)
[1391](#1391)fn json_preview(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1392](#1392)    if let Ok(value) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(text) {
[1393](#1393)        if let Some(obj) = value.as_object() {
[1394](#1394)            let keys = obj.keys().take(12).cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
[1395](#1395)            return compact_preview(&format!("json keys: {keys}"), max_chars);
[1396](#1396)        }
[1397](#1397)    }
[1398](#1398)    compact_preview(text, max_chars)
[1399](#1399)}
[1400](#1400)
[1401](#1401)fn detect_content_kind(role: &str, content: &str) -> ContentKind {
[1402](#1402)    let trimmed = content.trim();
[1403](#1403)    let lower = trimmed.to_lowercase();
[1404](#1404)    if serde_json::from_str::<Value>(trimmed).is_ok() {
[1405](#1405)        return ContentKind::Json;
[1406](#1406)    }
[1407](#1407)    if lower.starts_with("diff --git") || lower.contains("\n@@ ") {
[1408](#1408)        return ContentKind::Diff;
[1409](#1409)    }
[1410](#1410)    if lower.contains("error[")
[1411](#1411)        || lower.contains("test result:")
[1412](#1412)        || lower.contains("warning:")
[1413](#1413)        || lower.contains("compiling ")
[1414](#1414)    {
[1415](#1415)        return ContentKind::CargoOutput;
[1416](#1416)    }
[1417](#1417)    if trimmed.starts_with("# ") || trimmed.contains("\n## ") || trimmed.contains("\n- ") {
[1418](#1418)        return ContentKind::Markdown;
[1419](#1419)    }
[1420](#1420)    if lower.contains("fn main") || lower.contains("pub struct") || lower.contains("impl ") {
[1421](#1421)        return ContentKind::Rust;
[1422](#1422)    }
[1423](#1423)    if looks_like_search_results(trimmed) {
[1424](#1424)        return ContentKind::SearchResults;
[1425](#1425)    }
[1426](#1426)    if role == "tool" {
[1427](#1427)        return ContentKind::ShellLog;
[1428](#1428)    }
[1429](#1429)    ContentKind::PlainText
[1430](#1430)}
[1431](#1431)
[1432](#1432)fn looks_like_search_results(text: &str) -> bool {
[1433](#1433)    let mut path_line_count = 0usize;
[1434](#1434)    for line in text.lines().take(1_000) {
[1435](#1435)        let lower = line.to_lowercase();
[1436](#1436)        let has_path = lower.contains("/home/")
[1437](#1437)            || lower.contains("/tmp/")
[1438](#1438)            || lower.contains(".rs:")
[1439](#1439)            || lower.contains(".py:")
[1440](#1440)            || lower.contains(".md:")
[1441](#1441)            || lower.contains(".toml:")
[1442](#1442)            || lower.contains(".yaml:")
[1443](#1443)            || lower.contains(".json:");
[1444](#1444)        let has_location_separator = line.matches(':').count() >= 2;
[1445](#1445)        if has_path && has_location_separator {
[1446](#1446)            path_line_count += 1;
[1447](#1447)        }
[1448](#1448)    }
[1449](#1449)    path_line_count >= 1
[1450](#1450)}
[1451](#1451)
[1452](#1452)fn enforce_budget(
[1453](#1453)    mut messages: Vec<Message>,
[1454](#1454)    policy: &CompactionPolicy,
[1455](#1455)    warnings: &mut Vec<String>,
[1456](#1456)) -> Result<Vec<Message>, ContextGovernorError> {
[1457](#1457)    let target = policy.target_tokens;
[1458](#1458)    if count_tokens_messages(&messages, policy) <= target {
[1459](#1459)        return Ok(messages);
[1460](#1460)    }
[1461](#1461)    let Some(summary_idx) = messages
[1462](#1462)        .iter()
[1463](#1463)        .position(|m| m.content.starts_with(SUMMARY_PREFIX))
[1464](#1464)    else {
[1465](#1465)        let minimum = count_tokens_messages(&messages, policy);
[1466](#1466)        return Err(ContextGovernorError::BudgetExceeded {
[1467](#1467)            target_tokens: target,
[1468](#1468)            minimum_required_tokens: minimum,
[1469](#1469)        });
[1470](#1470)    };
[1471](#1471)
[1472](#1472)    let mut without_summary = messages.clone();
[1473](#1473)    without_summary.remove(summary_idx);
[1474](#1474)    let required = count_tokens_messages(&without_summary, policy);
[1475](#1475)    if required > target {
[1476](#1476)        if matches!(policy.budget_mode, BudgetMode::HardCascade) {
[1477](#1477)            warnings.push(format!(
[1478](#1478)                "hard cascade removed summary but exact protected minimum still exceeds target budget: {required} > {target} tokens"
[1479](#1479)            ));
[1480](#1480)            return Ok(without_summary);
[1481](#1481)        }
[1482](#1482)        return Err(ContextGovernorError::BudgetExceeded {
[1483](#1483)            target_tokens: target,
[1484](#1484)            minimum_required_tokens: required,
[1485](#1485)        });
[1486](#1486)    }
[1487](#1487)
[1488](#1488)    let available_chars = target
[1489](#1489)        .saturating_sub(required)
[1490](#1490)        .saturating_mul(CHARS_PER_TOKEN);
[1491](#1491)    let minimal_summary = minimal_recovery_summary(&messages[summary_idx].content);
[1492](#1492)    let minimal_tokens = count_tokens_text(&minimal_summary, policy) + 4;
[1493](#1493)    if available_chars < 80 {
[1494](#1494)        if required + minimal_tokens <= target {
[1495](#1495)            messages[summary_idx].content = minimal_summary;
[1496](#1496)            warnings.push("hard cascade reduced summary to minimal recovery pointer".to_string());
[1497](#1497)        } else {
[1498](#1498)            messages.remove(summary_idx);
[1499](#1499)            warnings.push("hard cascade removed summary to satisfy target budget".to_string());
[1500](#1500)        }
[1501](#1501)        return Ok(messages);
[1502](#1502)    }
[1503](#1503)
[1504](#1504)    let summary = &mut messages[summary_idx];
[1505](#1505)    if summary.content.chars().count() > available_chars {
[1506](#1506)        let truncated_body = summary
[1507](#1507)            .content
[1508](#1508)            .chars()
[1509](#1509)            .take(available_chars.saturating_sub(96))
[1510](#1510)            .collect::<String>();
[1511](#1511)        summary.content = format!(
[1512](#1512)            "{}\nhard cascade summary truncated; exact fallback remains available.\n{}",
[1513](#1513)            SUMMARY_PREFIX, truncated_body
[1514](#1514)        );
[1515](#1515)        if count_tokens_messages(&messages, policy) > target && required + minimal_tokens <= target
[1516](#1516)        {
[1517](#1517)            messages[summary_idx].content = minimal_summary;
[1518](#1518)        }
[1519](#1519)        warnings.push("hard cascade truncated summary to satisfy target budget".to_string());
[1520](#1520)    }
[1521](#1521)    if count_tokens_messages(&messages, policy) > target {
[1522](#1522)        messages.remove(summary_idx);
[1523](#1523)        warnings.push("hard cascade removed summary after truncation did not fit".to_string());
[1524](#1524)    }
[1525](#1525)    Ok(messages)
[1526](#1526)}
[1527](#1527)
[1528](#1528)fn minimal_recovery_summary(summary: &str) -> String {
[1529](#1529)    let mut lines = vec![
[1530](#1530)        SUMMARY_PREFIX.to_string(),
[1531](#1531)        "Hard cascade kept only the recovery pointer; exact fallback remains available."
[1532](#1532)            .to_string(),
[1533](#1533)    ];
[1534](#1534)    for line in summary.lines() {
[1535](#1535)        if line.contains("context_expand(") || line.starts_with("- fallback_item_ids:") {
[1536](#1536)            lines.push(compact_preview(line, 600));
[1537](#1537)        }
[1538](#1538)    }
[1539](#1539)    lines.join("\n")
[1540](#1540)}

[1599](#1599)pub fn context_expand(
[1600](#1600)    response: &CompactResponse,
[1601](#1601)    item_id: &str,
[1602](#1602)    max_chars: usize,
[1603](#1603)) -> Option<ContextExpandResult> {
[1604](#1604)    response
[1605](#1605)        .exact_store
[1606](#1606)        .iter()
[1607](#1607)        .find(|item| item.item_id == item_id)
[1608](#1608)        .map(|item| {
[1609](#1609)            let total_chars = item.content.chars().count();
[1610](#1610)            let truncated = total_chars > max_chars;
[1611](#1611)            let content = if truncated {
[1612](#1612)                item.content.chars().take(max_chars).collect::<String>()
[1613](#1613)            } else {
[1614](#1614)                item.content.clone()
[1615](#1615)            };
[1616](#1616)            ContextExpandResult {
[1617](#1617)                item_id: item.item_id.clone(),
[1618](#1618)                content,
[1619](#1619)                content_blake3: item.content_blake3.clone(),
[1620](#1620)                truncated,
[1621](#1621)            }
[1622](#1622)        })
[1623](#1623)}
[1624](#1624)
[1625](#1625)pub fn context_search(
[1626](#1626)    response: &CompactResponse,
[1627](#1627)    query: &str,
[1628](#1628)    top_k: usize,
[1629](#1629)    scope: SearchScope,
[1630](#1630)) -> Vec<ContextSearchHit> {
[1631](#1631)    let query_l = query.to_lowercase();
[1632](#1632)    let mut scored_hits = Vec::new();
[1633](#1633)
[1634](#1634)    let mut add_hit = |source: &'static str,
[1635](#1635)                       rank: usize,
[1636](#1636)                       item_id: Option<String>,
[1637](#1637)                       rendered: &str,
[1638](#1638)                       hash: Option<String>| {
[1639](#1639)        if rendered.to_lowercase().contains(&query_l) {
[1640](#1640)            scored_hits.push((
[1641](#1641)                rank,
[1642](#1642)                ContextSearchHit {
[1643](#1643)                    source: source.to_string(),
[1644](#1644)                    item_id,
[1645](#1645)                    snippet: snippet_around(rendered, query, 320),
[1646](#1646)                    content_blake3: hash,
[1647](#1647)                },
[1648](#1648)            ));
[1649](#1649)        }
[1650](#1650)    };
[1651](#1651)
[1652](#1652)    if matches!(scope, SearchScope::All | SearchScope::ExactStore) {
[1653](#1653)        for item in &response.exact_store {
[1654](#1654)            add_hit(
[1655](#1655)                "exact_store",
[1656](#1656)                90,
[1657](#1657)                Some(item.item_id.clone()),
[1658](#1658)                &item.content,
[1659](#1659)                Some(item.content_blake3.clone()),
[1660](#1660)            );
[1661](#1661)        }
[1662](#1662)    }
[1663](#1663)
[1664](#1664)    if matches!(scope, SearchScope::All | SearchScope::Summary) {
[1665](#1665)        for msg in &response.compacted_messages {
[1666](#1666)            add_hit(
[1667](#1667)                "compacted_messages",
[1668](#1668)                60,
[1669](#1669)                msg.id.clone(),
[1670](#1670)                &msg.content,
[1671](#1671)                Some(hash_text(&msg.content)),
[1672](#1672)            );
[1673](#1673)        }
[1674](#1674)    }
[1675](#1675)
[1676](#1676)    if matches!(scope, SearchScope::All | SearchScope::Receipt) {
[1677](#1677)        if let Ok(rendered) = serde_json::to_string(&response.receipt) {
[1678](#1678)            add_hit(
[1679](#1679)                "receipt",
[1680](#1680)                40,
[1681](#1681)                Some(response.receipt.receipt_id.clone()),
[1682](#1682)                &rendered,
[1683](#1683)                Some(hash_text(&rendered)),
[1684](#1684)            );
[1685](#1685)        }
[1686](#1686)    }
[1687](#1687)
[1688](#1688)    scored_hits.sort_by(|a, b| {
[1689](#1689)        b.0.cmp(&a.0)
[1690](#1690)            .then_with(|| a.1.source.cmp(&b.1.source))
[1691](#1691)            .then_with(|| a.1.snippet.cmp(&b.1.snippet))
[1692](#1692)    });
[1693](#1693)
[1694](#1694)    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
[1695](#1695)    let mut hits = Vec::new();
[1696](#1696)    for (_, hit) in scored_hits {
[1697](#1697)        let key = format!(
[1698](#1698)            "{}:{}",
[1699](#1699)            hit.source,
[1700](#1700)            hit.item_id.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "receipt".to_string())
[1701](#1701)        );
[1702](#1702)        if seen.insert(key) {
[1703](#1703)            hits.push(hit);
[1704](#1704)            if hits.len() >= top_k {
[1705](#1705)                break;
[1706](#1706)            }
[1707](#1707)        }
[1708](#1708)    }
[1709](#1709)
[1710](#1710)    hits
[1711](#1711)}
[1712](#1712)
[1713](#1713)pub fn context_diff(response: &CompactResponse) -> ContextDiffSummary {
[1714](#1714)    let mut content_kind_reductions: BTreeMap<String, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
[1715](#1715)    let reduced_ids = response
[1716](#1716)        .allocation_plan
[1717](#1717)        .summarized_item_ids
[1718](#1718)        .iter()
[1719](#1719)        .chain(response.allocation_plan.archived_item_ids.iter())
[1720](#1720)        .chain(response.allocation_plan.omitted_item_ids.iter())
[1721](#1721)        .chain(response.allocation_plan.quarantined_item_ids.iter())
[1722](#1722)        .cloned()
[1723](#1723)        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
[1724](#1724)    for item in &response.allocation_plan.items {
[1725](#1725)        if reduced_ids.contains(&item.item_id) {
[1726](#1726)            *content_kind_reductions
[1727](#1727)                .entry(format!("{:?}", item.content_kind))
[1728](#1728)                .or_insert(0) += 1;
[1729](#1729)        }
[1730](#1730)    }
[1731](#1731)    ContextDiffSummary {
[1732](#1732)        kept_count: response.allocation_plan.kept_item_ids.len(),
[1733](#1733)        summarized_count: response.allocation_plan.summarized_item_ids.len(),
[1734](#1734)        archived_count: response.allocation_plan.archived_item_ids.len(),
[1735](#1735)        omitted_count: response.allocation_plan.omitted_item_ids.len(),
[1736](#1736)        quarantined_count: response.allocation_plan.quarantined_item_ids.len(),
[1737](#1737)        original_approx_tokens: response.receipt.original_approx_tokens,
[1738](#1738)        compacted_approx_tokens: response.receipt.compacted_approx_tokens,
[1739](#1739)        token_savings_estimate: response.receipt.token_savings_estimate,
[1740](#1740)        warnings: response.receipt.warnings.clone(),
[1741](#1741)        content_kind_reductions,
[1742](#1742)    }
[1743](#1743)}
[1744](#1744)
[1745](#1745)fn snippet_around(content: &str, query: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1746](#1746)    let content_l = content.to_lowercase();
[1747](#1747)    let query_l = query.to_lowercase();
[1748](#1748)    let start_byte = content_l
[1749](#1749)        .find(&query_l)
[1750](#1750)        .map(|idx| floor_char_boundary(content, idx.saturating_sub(max_chars / 3)))
[1751](#1751)        .unwrap_or(0);
[1752](#1752)    let mut snippet = content[start_byte..]
[1753](#1753)        .chars()
[1754](#1754)        .take(max_chars)
[1755](#1755)        .collect::<String>();
[1756](#1756)    if snippet.chars().count() == max_chars {
[1757](#1757)        snippet.push_str("...");
[1758](#1758)    }
[1759](#1759)    snippet
[1760](#1760)}
[1761](#1761)
[1762](#1762)fn floor_char_boundary(text: &str, mut idx: usize) -> usize {
[1763](#1763)    idx = idx.min(text.len());
[1764](#1764)    while idx > 0 && !text.is_char_boundary(idx) {
[1765](#1765)        idx -= 1;
[1766](#1766)    }
[1767](#1767)    idx
[1768](#1768)}

[1825](#1825)pub fn build_replay_probes(messages: &[Message], max_probes: usize) -> Vec<ReplayProbe> {
[1826](#1826)    let mut probes = Vec::new();
[1827](#1827)    if let Some(latest_user) = messages.iter().rev().find(|message| message.role == "user") {
[1828](#1828)        push_probe(
[1829](#1829)            &mut probes,
[1830](#1830)            "active_task",
[1831](#1831)            literal_probe_fragment(&latest_user.content, 120),
[1832](#1832)            max_probes,
[1833](#1833)        );
[1834](#1834)    }
[1835](#1835)
[1836](#1836)    for message in messages {
[1837](#1837)        let content_l = message.content.to_lowercase();
[1838](#1838)        if content_l.contains("acceptance gate") || content_l.contains("must pass") {
[1839](#1839)            push_probe(
[1840](#1840)                &mut probes,
[1841](#1841)                "acceptance_gate",
[1842](#1842)                important_lines(&message.content, &["acceptance gate", "must pass"], 160),
[1843](#1843)                max_probes,
[1844](#1844)            );
[1845](#1845)        }
[1846](#1846)        if content_l.contains("decision:") || content_l.contains("decided") {
[1847](#1847)            push_probe(
[1848](#1848)                &mut probes,
[1849](#1849)                "decision",
[1850](#1850)                important_lines(&message.content, &["decision", "decided"], 160),
[1851](#1851)                max_probes,
[1852](#1852)            );
[1853](#1853)        }
[1854](#1854)        if content_l.contains("error")
[1855](#1855)            || content_l.contains("traceback")
[1856](#1856)            || content_l.contains("failed")
[1857](#1857)        {
[1858](#1858)            push_probe(
[1859](#1859)                &mut probes,
[1860](#1860)                "error",
[1861](#1861)                important_lines(&message.content, &["error", "traceback", "failed"], 160),
[1862](#1862)                max_probes,
[1863](#1863)            );
[1864](#1864)        }
[1865](#1865)        for file in extract_file_like_tokens(&message.content) {
[1866](#1866)            push_probe(&mut probes, "file", file, max_probes);
[1867](#1867)        }
[1868](#1868)        if probes.len() >= max_probes {
[1869](#1869)            break;
[1870](#1870)        }
[1871](#1871)    }
[1872](#1872)    probes
[1873](#1873)}

[1931](#1931)pub fn evaluate_replay_fixture(
[1932](#1932)    fixture_id: impl Into<String>,
[1933](#1933)    request: CompactRequest,
[1934](#1934)    max_probes: usize,

[1946](#1946)    let full_tokens = approx_tokens_messages(&request.messages);
[1947](#1947)    let head_tail_messages = head_tail_messages(&request.messages, 1, 1);
[1948](#1948)    let head_tail_text = join_message_content(&head_tail_messages);
[1949](#1949)    let head_tail_tokens = approx_tokens_messages(&head_tail_messages);
[1950](#1950)
[1951](#1951)    let response = compact_context(request)?;
[1952](#1952)    let compacted_text = join_message_content(&response.compacted_messages);
[1953](#1953)    let compacted_tokens = response.receipt.compacted_approx_tokens;
[1954](#1954)
[1955](#1955)    let baselines = vec![
[1956](#1956)        score_text_baseline("full", &full_text, full_tokens, &probes, active_task),
[1957](#1957)        score_text_baseline(
[1958](#1958)            "head_tail",
[1959](#1959)            &head_tail_text,
[1960](#1960)            head_tail_tokens,
[1961](#1961)            &probes,
[1962](#1962)            active_task,
[1963](#1963)        ),
[1964](#1964)        score_context_governor(
[1965](#1965)            &response,
[1966](#1966)            &compacted_text,
[1967](#1967)            compacted_tokens,
[1968](#1968)            &probes,
[1969](#1969)            active_task,
[1970](#1970)        ),
[1971](#1971)    ];
[1972](#1972)
[1973](#1973)    Ok(ReplayFixtureReport {
[1974](#1974)        fixture_id,
[1975](#1975)        original_message_count,
[1976](#1976)        compacted_message_count: response.compacted_messages.len(),
[1977](#1977)        probes,
[1978](#1978)        baselines,
[1979](#1979)        receipt_id: response.receipt.receipt_id,
[1980](#1980)        warnings: response.receipt.warnings,
[1981](#1981)    })

[1984](#1984)fn literal_probe_fragment(text: &str, max_chars: usize) -> String {
[1985](#1985)    text.split_whitespace()
[1986](#1986)        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[1987](#1987)        .join(" ")
[1988](#1988)        .chars()
[1989](#1989)        .take(max_chars)
[1990](#1990)        .collect()

[1992](#1992)
[1993](#1993)fn push_probe(probes: &mut Vec<ReplayProbe>, category: &str, needle: String, max_probes: usize) {
[1994](#1994)    let mut needle = compact_preview(needle.trim(), 180);
[1995](#1995)    if let Some(stripped) = needle.strip_suffix("...") {
[1996](#1996)        needle = stripped.to_string();
[1997](#1997)    }
[1998](#1998)    if needle.len() < 4 || probes.len() >= max_probes {
[1999](#1999)        return;
[2000](#2000)    }
[2001](#2001)    if probes.iter().any(|probe| probe.needle == needle) {
[2002](#2002)        return;
[2003](#2003)    }
[2004](#2004)    probes.push(ReplayProbe {
[2005](#2005)        category: category.to_string(),
[2006](#2006)        needle,
[2007](#2007)    });
[2008](#2008)}

[2010](#2010)fn join_message_content(messages: &[Message]) -> String {
[2011](#2011)    messages
[2012](#2012)        .iter()
[2013](#2013)        .map(|message| message.content.as_str())
[2014](#2014)        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[2015](#2015)        .join("\n")
[2016](#2016)}
[2017](#2017)
[2018](#2018)fn head_tail_messages(messages: &[Message], head: usize, tail: usize) -> Vec<Message> {
[2019](#2019)    if messages.len() <= head + tail {
[2020](#2020)        return messages.to_vec();
[2021](#2021)    }
[2022](#2022)    messages
[2023](#2023)        .iter()
[2024](#2024)        .take(head)
[2025](#2025)        .chain(messages.iter().skip(messages.len().saturating_sub(tail)))
[2026](#2026)        .cloned()
[2027](#2027)        .collect()
[2028](#2028)}

[2080](#2080)fn score_answerability_context_governor(
[2081](#2081)    response: &CompactResponse,
[2082](#2082)    compacted_text: &str,
[2083](#2083)    tokens: usize,
[2084](#2084)    questions: &[ReplayAnswerabilityQuestion],
[2085](#2085)    active_task: &str,
[2086](#2086)) -> ReplayAnswerabilityBaselineScore {
[2087](#2087)    let answerable = questions
[2088](#2088)        .iter()
[2089](#2089)        .filter(|question| {
[2090](#2090)            question.expected_terms.iter().all(|term| {
[2091](#2091)                text_contains_probe(compacted_text, term)
[2092](#2092)                    || !context_search(response, term, 1, SearchScope::All).is_empty()
[2093](#2093)            })
[2094](#2094)        })
[2095](#2095)        .count();
[2096](#2096)    let incorrect_action_risk = questions
[2097](#2097)        .iter()
[2098](#2098)        .filter(|question| forbidden_terms_present(compacted_text, question))
[2099](#2099)        .count();
[2100](#2100)    build_answerability_score(
[2101](#2101)        "context_governor",
[2102](#2102)        answerable,
[2103](#2103)        questions.len(),
[2104](#2104)        incorrect_action_risk,
[2105](#2105)        tokens,
[2106](#2106)        text_contains_probe(compacted_text, active_task),
[2107](#2107)    )

[2109](#2109)
[2110](#2110)fn answerability_terms_present(text: &str, question: &ReplayAnswerabilityQuestion) -> bool {
[2111](#2111)    question
[2112](#2112)        .expected_terms
[2113](#2113)        .iter()
[2114](#2114)        .all(|term| text_contains_probe(text, term))
[2115](#2115)}
[2116](#2116)
[2117](#2117)fn forbidden_terms_present(text: &str, question: &ReplayAnswerabilityQuestion) -> bool {
[2118](#2118)    let text_l = text.to_lowercase();
[2119](#2119)    question.forbidden_terms.iter().any(|term| {
[2120](#2120)        let term_l = term.to_lowercase();
[2121](#2121)        let negated = text_l.contains(&format!("not {term_l}"))
[2122](#2122)            || text_l.contains(&format!("no {term_l}"))
[2123](#2123)            || text_l.contains(&format!("avoid {term_l}"));
[2124](#2124)        !negated && text_contains_probe(text, term)
[2125](#2125)    })

[2128](#2128)fn build_answerability_score(
[2129](#2129)    name: &str,
[2130](#2130)    answerable_questions: usize,
[2131](#2131)    total_questions: usize,
[2132](#2132)    incorrect_action_risk: usize,
[2133](#2133)    tokens: usize,
[2134](#2134)    active_task_visible: bool,
[2135](#2135)) -> ReplayAnswerabilityBaselineScore {
[2136](#2136)    let denominator = total_questions.max(1) as f64;
[2137](#2137)    ReplayAnswerabilityBaselineScore {
[2138](#2138)        name: name.to_string(),
[2139](#2139)        answerable_questions,
[2140](#2140)        total_questions,
[2141](#2141)        answerability_rate: answerable_questions as f64 / denominator,
[2142](#2142)        incorrect_action_risk,
[2143](#2143)        tokens,
[2144](#2144)        active_task_visible,
[2145](#2145)    }

[2148](#2148)fn score_context_governor(
[2149](#2149)    response: &CompactResponse,

[2152](#2152)    probes: &[ReplayProbe],

[2157](#2157)        .filter(|probe| text_contains_probe(compacted_text, &probe.needle))
[2158](#2158)        .count();
[2159](#2159)    let recoverable = probes
[2160](#2160)        .iter()
[2161](#2161)        .filter(|probe| !context_search(response, &probe.needle, 1, SearchScope::All).is_empty())
[2162](#2162)        .count();
[2163](#2163)    build_score(
[2164](#2164)        "context_governor",
[2165](#2165)        visible,
[2166](#2166)        recoverable,
[2167](#2167)        probes.len(),

[2173](#2173)fn build_score(
[2174](#2174)    name: &str,
[2175](#2175)    visible_probes: usize,
[2176](#2176)    recoverable_probes: usize,
[2177](#2177)    total_probes: usize,
[2178](#2178)    tokens: usize,
[2179](#2179)    active_task_visible: bool,
[2180](#2180)) -> ReplayBaselineScore {
[2181](#2181)    let denominator = total_probes.max(1) as f64;
[2182](#2182)    ReplayBaselineScore {
[2183](#2183)        name: name.to_string(),
[2184](#2184)        visible_probes,
[2185](#2185)        recoverable_probes,
[2186](#2186)        total_probes,
[2187](#2187)        visible_rate: visible_probes as f64 / denominator,
[2188](#2188)        recoverable_rate: recoverable_probes as f64 / denominator,

[2218](#2218)
[2219](#2219)pub fn archive_response_to_memory(
[2220](#2220)    response: &CompactResponse,
[2221](#2221)    sink: &mut dyn MemorySink,
[2222](#2222)) -> Result<MemoryArchiveOutcome, ContextGovernorError> {
[2223](#2223)    let mut outcome = MemoryArchiveOutcome::default();
[2224](#2224)    for item in &response.allocation_plan.items {
[2225](#2225)        let should_archive = response
[2226](#2226)            .allocation_plan
[2227](#2227)            .archived_item_ids
[2228](#2228)            .contains(&item.item_id)
[2229](#2229)            || matches!(
[2230](#2230)                item.authority_class,
[2231](#2231)                AuthorityClass::DurableMemoryCandidate | AuthorityClass::EvidenceCritical
[2232](#2232)            );
[2233](#2233)        if !should_archive {
[2234](#2234)            continue;
[2235](#2235)        }
[2236](#2236)        let Some(stored) = response

[2337](#2337)    fn scan_receipts(&self) -> Result<(Vec<String>, u64, usize), ContextGovernorError> {
[2338](#2338)        if !self.root.exists() {
[2339](#2339)            return Ok((Vec::new(), 0, 0));
[2340](#2340)        }
[2341](#2341)        let mut ids = Vec::new();
[2342](#2342)        let mut total_bytes = 0u64;
[2343](#2343)        let mut stale_tmp_files_removed = 0usize;
[2344](#2344)        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&self.root)? {
[2345](#2345)            let entry = entry?;
[2346](#2346)            let path = entry.path();
[2347](#2347)            if path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("tmp") {
[2349](#2349)                if std::fs::remove_file(&path).is_ok() {
[2350](#2350)                    stale_tmp_files_removed += 1;
[2351](#2351)                }
[2352](#2352)                continue;
[2353](#2353)            }
[2354](#2354)            if path.extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) != Some("json") {
[2355](#2355)                continue;
[2356](#2356)            }
[2357](#2357)            if let Ok(metadata) = entry.metadata() {
[2358](#2358)                total_bytes = total_bytes.saturating_add(metadata.len());
[2359](#2359)            }
[2360](#2360)            if let Some(stem) = path.file_stem().and_then(|stem| stem.to_str()) {
[2361](#2361)                ids.push(stem.to_string());
[2362](#2362)            }
[2363](#2363)        }
[2364](#2364)        ids.sort();
[2365](#2365)        Ok((ids, total_bytes, stale_tmp_files_removed))
[2366](#2366)    }
